title: The Remarkable memory of the old man
subtitle: 成功成就 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）
meta: 主题语境：成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）　|　核心词汇：remarkable　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 remarkable 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1988 the builder wrote of ① a remarkable memory of the old man in the plan, and everybody in the site said at once that it was ② more remarkable than the one named there the year before. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the builder, who never explained anything, had done it in the rain and gone home; it was the remarkable ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most remarkable memory of the old man anybody in the site had ever seen, or so the plan for October 1982 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too remarkable to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the assistant who had come to help; the remarkable ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the beam at the far wall, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a remarkable change in the village, and said that no assistant in his right mind would call it ⑥ as remarkable as the change in the village they had once had in the old site. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was remarkable or not, and he said so.

By 1995 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the plan. What the line asked for was ⑦ something remarkable, and nothing besides. The assistant from the next site called the whole plan ⑧ quite remarkable; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the plan kept the names of the remarkable ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1998, without complaint, she wrote of another remarkable memory of the old man in the same plan, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ more remarkable than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most remarkable change in the village in the whole site, she said in 2000, was the one she could never quite name; the remarkable ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 非凡（前置定语 a remarkable memory of the old man：1988 年施工员在施工图里记下的那件非凡的记忆力）
B. adj. 非凡／引人注目（比较级 more remarkable than：文中两处，一处比老人非凡的记忆力，一处比预想）
C. adj. 非凡／引人注目（最高级 the most remarkable：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 非凡（表语 too remarkable to do：母亲觉得它太非凡，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 引人注目（前置定语 a remarkable change in the village：叔叔把整件事称作一桩引人注目的显著变化）
F. adj. 引人注目（同级比较 as remarkable as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩村子的显著变化相比）
G. adj. 引人注目（后置定语 something remarkable：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 引人注目（受程度副词修饰 quite remarkable：那位帮工的评价）

items.q: a remarkable memory of the old man
the most remarkable memory of the old man anybody
a remarkable change in the village
The most remarkable change in the village in

answers.why: remarkable 意为“非凡”，1988 年施工员在施工图里记下的是“一件非凡的记忆力”，此处作前置定语 a remarkable memory of the old man。
remarkable 意为“非凡”，此处用比较级 more remarkable than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
remarkable 意为“非凡”，施工图上 十月 那行字说它是工地里最非凡的一件，故用最高级 the most remarkable memory of the old man。
remarkable 意为“非凡”，母亲认为这件东西“太非凡了，谁也用不上”，too remarkable to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
remarkable 意为“引人注目”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩引人注目的显著变化”，此处作前置定语 a remarkable change in the village。
remarkable 意为“引人注目”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩村子的显著变化一样引人注目”，同级比较用 as remarkable as。
remarkable 意为“引人注目”，施工图上那半行字要的是“引人注目的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something remarkable。
remarkable 意为“引人注目”，邻工地来的那位帮工认为这套计划“相当引人注目”，quite 修饰原级 remarkable。
remarkable 意为“引人注目”，1998 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要引人注目”，故用比较级 more remarkable than。
remarkable 意为“引人注目”，母亲 2000 年说的是“整个工地里最引人注目的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most remarkable change in the village。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1988 年，施工员在施工图里记下了一件非凡的记忆力。（a remarkable memory of the old man）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更非凡。（more remarkable than …）
母亲觉得它太非凡，谁也用不上。（too remarkable to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩引人注目的显著变化。（a remarkable change in the village）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩村子的显著变化一样引人注目。（as remarkable as …）
到了 1995 年，施工图上只剩半行字：要的是一件引人注目的东西。（something remarkable）
answers: In 1988 the builder wrote of a remarkable memory of the old man in the plan.
Everybody said it was more remarkable than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too remarkable to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a remarkable change in the village.
He said nobody would call it as remarkable as the change in the village they had once had.
By 1995 the plan asked for nothing but something remarkable.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 remarkable 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1988 the builder wrote of a remarkable memory of the old man in the plan, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most remarkable memory of the old man in the site, or so the plan says.
My mother thought it too remarkable to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a remarkable change in the village, and nobody argued with him.
The assistant from the next site called the plan quite remarkable, and everybody laughed.
The remarkable ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
